Composite d still requires lower squarefreeness.

fusions.title: Odd-character moment bounds strengthen routed separator certificates
fusions.exactCombination: Use the odd-cardinality translation obstruction from C02 on the common low-rank rectangle produced by F018; optimize two-color separator grouping from a sixth to a third, and retain quantitative singular-value tails instead of exact-rank-only conclusions.
